SREcon27 Americas
SEATTLE, WA, USA
April 12–14, 2027
Talk proposals due November 19, 2026
SREcon27 Americas is a gathering of engineers who care deeply about site reliability, systems engineering, and working with complex distributed systems at scale. SREcon strives to challenge both those new to the profession as well as those who have been involved in it for decades. The conference has a culture of critical thought, deep technical insights, continuous improvement, and innovation.
Interested in participating? View the Call for Participation and submit your talk proposal by Thursday, November 19, 2026.
